verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Sentry's product dashboards for error/performance data and general pricing tiers, but contains no mention of billing/usage spend visibility, cost attribution to teams or services, or spike alerts on observability spend — a capability Sentry does document elsewhere (e.g. quota management, spike protection) but which is absent from this evidence set. missing for 10: spend/cost dashboards, per-team/service cost attribution, usage spike alerting or quota-based billing alerts.
